title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 23
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 23: the burden of Tyre, howling ships of Tarshish, Yahweh's plan against proud glory, and seventy forgotten years.

questions.text: Isaiah 23 is the burden of which city?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 opens with "The burden of Tyre," which is laid waste.

questions.text: Who is told to howl because their stronghold is laid waste?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says, "Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!"

questions.text: What was Tyre's revenue on great waters?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 says that on great waters the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue; she was the market of nations.

answers.text: The fine gold of the land of Ophir
The seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile
The silver of the ships of Tarshish

questions.text: Which city is told, "Be ashamed... for the sea has spoken"?
questions.explanation: Verse 4 says, "Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea."

questions.text: How does verse 8 describe Tyre's merchants?
questions.explanation: Verse 8 calls Tyre the giver of crowns, "whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth."

questions.text: Who has planned this against Tyre, and why?
questions.explanation: Verse 9 says Yahweh of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory and bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

answers.text: Yahweh of Armies, to stain the pride of all glory
The king of Babylon, to carry off her riches
The Assyrians, to rule over the great sea
Egypt, to avenge the harvest of the Nile

questions.text: Where is the oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon told to pass over to?
questions.explanation: Verse 12 says, "Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest."

questions.text: Who founded the land of the Chaldeans according to verse 13?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 says this people didn't exist; the Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness.

questions.text: For how long will Tyre be forgotten?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king.

questions.text: What will Tyre's merchandise and wages finally be?
questions.explanation: Verse 18 says her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to Yahweh, for those who dwell before Yahweh.

answers.text: Given to the king of Babylon
